objective: Proof: in Turaev-Viro form on ordered triangulations, positive weights for the Fibonacci knot or any of the six twisted Fibonacci knots cannot have full support, because some move identities have positive terms on one side only; every positive weighting of a twisted knot is supported on constant tetrahedra or on its parity class, and those of the no-lone knots also on the union of a parity class and a constant; exhaustive standard-library classification of supports.
status: Proved by TWIST-3D-20261025-001B-P001: for the Fibonacci and twisted Fibonacci triangle rules on ordered triangulations, positive Turaev-Viro weights cannot have full support (one-sided identities), every positive support lies on constants or the parity class (plus one constant for the no-lone knots), and on the parity class the 2-3 identities are pure gauge, so every positive state sum is 1, 2, |H1(M; Z2)|/2 or |H1(M; Z2)|/2 + 1: the sign survives the twist.
title: The sign survives the twist
